name: limpid
description: Limpid — an educational writing coach for academic prose. Scores against good writing (Orwell, Strunk & White, Hemingway, the Economist) and teaches why. Not a grammar/spell checker.

enumDescriptions: Prefer free Copilot, then any configured API key (recommended)
GitHub Copilot via the VS Code Language Model API (free tier works)
Local Claude Code CLI (`claude -p`) — uses your Claude subscription, no API key
Anthropic API (set the anthropic key via 'Limpid: Set API Key')
limpid.provider.markdownDescription: Which language-model provider powers the LLM judgment lenses. `auto` prefers free Copilot, then any API key you've set. API keys are stored in the OS keychain via **Limpid: Set API Key** — never in settings.

limpid.model.markdownDescription: Override the model id for the selected provider (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`). Empty = the provider's default.

limpid.audience.markdownDescription: Default target reader to judge audience-altitude against (e.g. `NeurIPS reviewer`, `ML newcomer`). Leave empty to let Limpid infer it; you can also change it per run in the panel.

enumDescriptions: Academic paper (precision + clarity carry the grade)
Blog / general audience (prize accessibility; easier readability target)
limpid.register.markdownDescription: Writing register — re-weights the grade and shifts readability targets so a blog post isn't graded like a paper. `auto` picks by file type.

limpid.reanalyzeOnSave.markdownDescription: Refresh the **deterministic** metrics when you save the file shown in the Coach view (only on save, never per-keystroke). This never spends an LLM request — the four writing lenses re-run only on an explicit Coach run, so a tight save loop can't burn your quota.

limpid.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show inline editor diagnostics (squiggles + Problems panel) for the deterministic checks — filler, passive voice, hedges, weak openers, undefined acronyms — refreshed on open/save. The LLM judgment lenses stay in the Coach view.

limpid.history.enabled.markdownDescription: Record one entry per coach run to `.limpid/history.json` to power the **Learn** view's recurring-pattern insight and grade trend. Disable to keep no history.

limpid.ollama.baseURL.markdownDescription: Base URL for the local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint (used when `limpid.provider` = `ollama`).

limpid.claudeCode.command.markdownDescription: Path/name of the Claude Code CLI binary (used when `limpid.provider` = `claude-code`).

limpid.openaiCompatible.baseURL.markdownDescription: Base URL for a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (used when `limpid.provider` = `openai-compatible`) — e.g. DeepSeek, Fireworks, xAI, Azure OpenAI, or a local proxy. Store its key under the **openai-compatible** slot via **Limpid: Set API Key** (falls back to the `openai` slot for back-compat); a keyless proxy needs none.

limpid.openaiCompatible.model.markdownDescription: Model id for the custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Limpid
walkthroughs.description: Coach a passage against good writing — and learn why.

steps.title: Coach a passage
steps.description:
Open a `.tex` or `.md` file, select a paragraph (or nothing, for the whole file), and run the coach.
[Coach this selection / section](command:limpid.coach)

steps.title: Pick a language model (optional)
steps.description:
The deterministic checks need no setup. The four judgment lenses use a model — free GitHub Copilot works, or set a key for any provider.
[Set API Key…](command:limpid.setApiKey)

steps.title: Learn the patterns
steps.description: Open the **Limpid** view in the Activity Bar. The **Learn** tab is a library of the named failure patterns and your trends over time.
